source_row.rationale: KDIGO classifies CKD using the CGA framework: Cause, GFR category, and Albuminuria category, so Option B is correct. Blood pressure, serum sodium, body mass index, and hemoglobin may be clinically important but are not the three components of the KDIGO CKD classification framework.
source_row.source_detail: KDIGO 2024 CKD Guideline, Definition and classification of CKD, Kidney International 105(Suppl 4S), printed p. S137: CKD is classified based on Cause, GFR category (G1-G5), and Albuminuria category (A1-A3), abbreviated CGA; Tables 2 and 3 define the GFR and albuminuria categories. KDIGO 2024 CKD Guideline remains the current global CKD guideline; focused Chapter 3 update is underway but has not superseded the classification section. PDF page S137 and currentness live-rechecked 2026-08-15. NCSBN first-check: Client Needs — Physiological Integrity — Reduction of Risk Potential: diagnostic probability tools, laboratory/tumor-marker interpretation, ECG/lab monitoring and potential complications. 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan; effective 2026-04-01 through 2029-03-31; currentness rechecked 2026-08-15.
